description: This file defines a PHP class LoggerSubscriber that subscribes to Symfony kernel exception events and logs exception details using a custom Logger service.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class for handling kernel exception events and logging exception details.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically kernel exception events.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events by logging the exception message and trace.
